migration.threshold_scope: experimental fixed 0.50; archived known-person probes checked; live unknown-person not validated

optional_diagnostics.thread_cpu_scope: calling thread only; excludes other native/runtime/kernel threads
optional_diagnostics.wall_scope: optional gate and VART API walls; includes wait/descheduling/GIL; not pure hardware time
optional_diagnostics.normal_timing_scope: completed native wait with status 0; no body failure, hard-cap or guard overrun
optional_diagnostics.normal_trace_scope: one maximum optional wall trace across both tasks; first wins ties

thread_sched_observer.stop_rule: CPU read >0.5ms; wall read >2ms if CPU clock missing; low-CPU late wall reads stay flagged
thread_sched_observer.scope: calling thread switch counts only; cannot time CPU runqueue or identify GIL/native root cause
thread_sched_observer.observer_cost_scope: original optional hard cap includes all observation work; never subtracted

pipeline_metrics.quantile_scope: most recent bounded samples per stage; not all calls or health-snapshot quantiles
pipeline_metrics.source_age_scope: existing appsink-dequeue timestamp; not sensor exposure or glass-to-glass
pipeline_metrics.yolo_native_scope: native preprocessing + DPU + native decode; not DPU-only time

optional_diagnostics.normal_trace_scope: one maximum optional wall trace across both tasks; first wins ties

freshness_metrics.clock_scope: existing service source clock; assumes monotonic service millis; no independent clock comparison
freshness_metrics.gap_scope: pre-check/post-commit bounds clipped after previous post-commit observation; no head/tail extrapolation
freshness_metrics.post_commit_ttl_scope: observation age reaching TTL is not proof of accepting stale input at the original gate
freshness_metrics.snapshot_scope: recorder only; enclosing health caller may hold the shared service RLock
